payload.reason: The evidence provides specific metrics and methods for evaluating models in the human-machine communication game, including efficiency and accuracy measures.

claims.text: Models are evaluated based on the retention rate of tokens, which measures the fraction of tokens kept in the keywords.
The accuracy of a communication scheme is measured by the fraction of sentences generated that exactly match the target sentence.
The evaluation also considers the efficiency of using fewer keywords and the interpretability of the communication scheme.
